    if activity == "Create Purchase Order":
        start_time = datetime.strptime("2023-12-06 19:49:00+00:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%z")
    elif activity == "Approve Purchase Order":
        start_time = datetime.strptime("2023-12-06 20:00:00+00:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%z")
    elif activity == "Create Goods Receipt":
        start_time = datetime.strptime("2023-12-07 09:30:00+00:00", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%z")
    elif activity == "Create Goods Receipt":
